configuration.numerical_source_note: Frozen native-qualified executable from numerical source 30a472fd; merged main 9b52b5af and audited worktree db61e84 have identical trees. No build is requested.

physical_configuration.regularization: per arm: none for no-igr; igr for the three fixed arms
physical_configuration.IGR_c_alpha_note: c_alpha and alpha-length apply only to the three IGR arms; no sigma solver exists in the no-IGR arm.
physical_configuration.initial_condition: Existing Gaussian Sedov deposition: E_blast=1, ambient rho=1 and p=1, zero velocity, width=6/32, centered at (0.5,0.5), gamma=1.4; independent of the 512x512 mesh resolution.

common_operator.A: IGR arms: original FP64 consistent mass/diffusion/exact SIPG face operator with current coefficients every stage. No-IGR: physical Euler only, no sigma assembly/preparation/solve.
common_operator.P: IGR arms: same projected element-local spectral inverse and current heterogeneous mass scaling; separate FP64 SIMT or FP64 WMMA execution.
common_operator.fused_solution_update: 0 for both isolation arms; 1 for production WMMA
common_operator.Euler_residual: same strict MFEM native packed FP64 SIMT fused DGSEM residual in all arms; DGSEM_FUSED_DMMA=0

no-igr.label: DGSEM physical Euler Rusanov, no IGR

fixed-simt-fp64.label: DGSEM fixed 50/2, omega=0.7, projected local FP64 SIMT P, separate solution update

fixed-wmma-fp64.label: DGSEM fixed 50/2, omega=0.7, projected local FP64 WMMA P, separate solution update

fixed-wmma-production.label: DGSEM fixed 50/2, omega=0.7, projected local FP64 WMMA P, fused solution update

environment_policy.control_names: Canonical unprefixed keys; runner clears inherited IGRLAB_ and DG_IGR_ variables and applies each control under both aliases
environment_policy.CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: preserve scheduler binding; never choose a second device

diagnostic_policy.note: Existing wall timing partitions are identical across arms. No profiler, event capture, true-residual probe, or new instrumentation. Fixed sweeps have no convergence certificate.

count_expectations.basis: Prior full fixed50/2 omega.7 DGSEM Sedov trajectory, prediction only; no-IGR flow/CFL can change actual counts.
count_expectations.rhs_formula: report actual; expected 3*accepted_steps+1 for this application lifecycle
count_expectations.correction_counters: One current A and one P application per fixed correction; no extra true-residual probe.

pair_meanings: physical and cost effect of current production IGR
hardware execution with matched separate update
benefit and rounding effect of solution-update fusion
comparison_policy.minor_CFL_step_count_differences: Report actual counts; do not reject solely for differing counts.
comparison_policy.sigma: Compare IGR arms separately; no-IGR native output has no sigma field. For explicit no-closure comparisons only, synthesize a marked zero sigma polynomial in analysis.
comparison_policy.physical_sampling: Existing mapped Q2/Q5 native VTU GL8 comparison; require finite saved/derived fields, positive sampled density and pressure, and q_sigma where applicable.
comparison_policy.q_sigma: q_sigma=gamma*p+(gamma-1)*sigma. For no-IGR derived Euler reference, sigma=0 and q_sigma=gamma*p; label the substitution explicitly.
error_metrics: absolute integral difference over reference GL L1
comparison_policy.error_thresholds: Report differences without inventing a user-approved pass budget; legacy comparator engineering budgets are descriptive only.
comparison_policy.fixed_residual: No convergence certificate or tolerance claim for fixed sweeps.
comparison_policy.accuracy_scope: No-IGR/IGR differences are method effects, not errors against truth. SIMT/WMMA differences isolate FP64 execution with fixed 50/2 sweeps and matching omega .7. No discretization-error or continuous positivity claim.
comparison_policy.ratios: Report raw application/advancing times and per-actual-RHS normalized times. No speed ratio for incomplete/unusable arms. One pass per arm gives no repeat-based confidence interval.

retention_policy.note: Compare all qualified finals remotely, then retain no-IGR and production WMMA native final VTUs with compact receipts within the inherited 3 GiB archive cap. Root runner may reduce field retention explicitly if necessary; all measured metrics and failures remain in compact receipts.

context_not_control.reason: Reuse physical controls, frozen binary and mesh; do not reuse historical performance as a measured baseline.

interpretation_limits: No-IGR/IGR differences measure a change in numerical method, not accuracy against an analytic or discretization-error reference.
SIMT/WMMA hardware controls both use separate solution updates; the fourth WMMA arm separately measures production update fusion.
The same frozen numerical source, binary, Q2 mesh, p5 GLL discretization, CFL, output cadence, and one allocated GPU are shared across fresh trajectories.
All positivity/modal limiting and optional nonfinite/admissibility/conservation scans are off. Complete saved fields are checked offline.
Timing is one unprofiled full trajectory per arm, not repeated-trial confidence intervals; native host sub-timers are not exclusive GPU phase costs.
Both total native RHS and three-times-accepted-step stage RHS denominators are reported; no-IGR may have different lifecycle or CFL work.
Fixed IGR has no residual convergence certificate. Rounded FP64 execution differences are reported separately from the regularization effect.
GL8 positivity and extrema are sampled at saved endpoints, not continuous/all-time positivity guarantees. Initial/final conserved integrals are separately reported when analyses complete.
Only this fixed large 2D mapped p5 DGSEM case is measured; no lower-precision, 3D or MPI performance claim.
